propositions: The existing contract suite is backend-agnostic and cannot detect Jira-specific mapping regressions during unit extraction.
A silent mapping change during moving units out of adapters/jira/ could pass CI undetected without characterization oracles.
Characterization tests must pin, by exact expected value, the current output of every unit slated to move.
Value maps must be asserted for all keys and for an unmapped key hitting the documented default (To Do / Medium).
This story extends only test_backend_characterization.py with no src/ modification.
Mutation checks must confirm that altering a pinned source value turns the corresponding characterization test RED.
